entities.name: Tenant
entities.rationale: Upper stick figure drawn left of the CDN dashed lines; represents the tenant using the web wizard to create events. Outside the CDN boundary.

entities.name: Customer
entities.rationale: Lower stick figure drawn left of the CDN dashed lines; represents the customer coming from omni-channel sources (mobile app, website, third-party resellers/OTAs). Outside the CDN boundary.

entities.name: CDN
entities.rationale: Two vertical dashed lines labeled 'CDN' forming a boundary column between the users and the AWS services; all requests pass through it. Not an icon, drawn as a dashed container/band.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon (AWS_Icon_6) labeled S3, top of diagram to the right of CDN; hosts static website content served through the CDN.

entities.name: AppSync
entities.rationale: Red icon (AWS_Icon_5) labeled APPSYNC, right of CDN; GraphQL gateway with resolvers to Lambda and direct DynamoDB resolvers.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Purple icon (AWS_Icon_1) labeled API GATEWAY, bottom left right of CDN; REST endpoint for third-party resellers/OTAs.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon (AWS_Icon_3) labeled LAMBDA in the center; processes requests from AppSync and API Gateway, interacts with DynamoDB and SQS.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue icon (AWS_Icon_4) labeled DYNAMODB on the right; multi-tenant tables partitioned by tenant key.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Pink icon (AWS_Icon_2) labeled SQS below Lambda; receives fan-out messages from Lambda that are later reprocessed by Lambda.

visual_connections.description: Arrow from the upper stick figure to the CDN dashed line (request from the tenant web application).
Curved arrow from the CDN dashed line back to the upper stick figure (CDN returns content to the client).
Arrow from the lower stick figure to the CDN dashed line (customer request hits the CDN first).
Double-headed arrow between the CDN dashed line and S3 (static content fetched and returned).
Arrow from CDN to AppSync (dynamic content / GraphQL requests).
Arrow from CDN to API Gateway (third-party reseller REST API requests).
Arrow from AppSync to Lambda (resolvers invoke Lambda).
Line from AppSync going up and over Lambda, ending in an arrow at the top of DynamoDB (direct DynamoDB resolvers).
Curved arrow from API Gateway up to Lambda.
Double-headed arrow between Lambda and DynamoDB.
Arrow from Lambda down to SQS (Lambda sends messages).
Curved arrow from SQS back up to Lambda (messages later processed by Lambda).
